### Apple Silicon app

This prerelease adds a SwiftUI launcher for macOS 26 or later. Extract the ZIP and open Open SVPflow.app. The launcher checks its external Homebrew mpv 0.42+, Python and VapourSynth components and can open Terminal for installation on request. The app is ad-hoc signed and may require Gatekeeper approval.

- Now Playing shows the current movie, interpolation, target frame rate and recent playback quality. Details expands the mpv diagnostics. Repeated playback problems can suggest lighter settings. Fixed FPS appears when that target mode is selected.
- The app interface supports English, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Modern Standard Arabic, French, Bangla, Portuguese (Portugal), Indonesian, Urdu, Russian, German and Japanese. Settings includes a shortcut to the macOS app language controls.
- Open several files to create a playlist. Newly opened files can join the queue or replace it. The GUI exits by default when playback begins. It can also stay open or move to the menu bar. Reopening reconnects to the independent mpv session. Interpolation settings apply to the next file.

The single ZIP contains the app and its signed plugins. Release CI verifies the extracted archive, signatures and playback.
